- I should NOT recommend emphasizing early-day delivery because that increases the risk of perceived delay given the MX12 transit extension and late-afternoon Apr 2 terminal availability.
- I should make this an internal communication/guidance response.

2. "Do not commit to an early-day delivery; set customer expectation for all-day April 3 to align with the revised internal PM target and protect service reliability."
